description: This file defines the JwtIssuerOptions class used for configuring JWT token issuance settings, including claims, validity period, and signing credentials in an ASP.NET Core application.

classes.name: JwtIssuerOptions
classes.description: A class providing configuration options for JWT token issuance, including claims, lifetime, and signing credentials.

methods.name: JtiGenerator
methods.description: A property returning a function that generates a new GUID string for the JWT ID claim.

methods.name: Expiration
methods.description: A property computing the expiration DateTime by adding ValidFor timespan to IssuedAt.

methods.name: IssuedAt
methods.description: A property returning the current UTC DateTime when the token is issued.

methods.name: NotBefore
methods.description: A property returning the current UTC DateTime, representing the 'not before' claim for token validity start.
